title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 098 ]

blocks.text: Most helpful to the calm and peaceful atmosphere that the two-year-old child needs but cannot produce for himself/herself is the presence of comforting music, in almost any form. Mother’s singing can help. Chanting a request, such as “Time to come to breakfast,” may be more effective than simply saying the request. Records, especially nursery rhymes, are just the thing for those periods at the end of the morning or afternoon when children are often easily irritated. Some children, especially boys, like to have their own music players and may play these for very long periods of time.

readingSentences.english: Most helpful to the calm and peaceful atmosphere that the two-year-old child needs but cannot produce for himself herself is the presence of comforting music, in almost any form.
readingSentences.korean: "2살된 어린이가 필요로 하지만, 기 스스로를 위하여 만들지 않은, 조용하고 평화스러운 분위기에 가장 도움이 되는것은 마음의 위로가 되는 음악이다. 어떤 형태로 되어 있던 간에.
엄마의 노래가 도움이 될 수도 있다.

readingSentences.korean: 가령, "아침 먹을 시간"과 같은 말을 노래로 읊조리는 것이 단순한 말보다 더 효과적일 수도 있다.

readingSentences.english: Records, especially nursery rhymes, are just the thing for those periods at the end of the morning or afternoon when children are often easily irritated.
readingSentences.korean: 특히 동요 같은, 녹음 곡이 어린들이 짜증스러운 아침이나 오후 늦은 시간에 딱 좋다.

readingSentences.english: Some children, especially boys, like to have their own music players and may play these for very long periods of time.
readingSentences.korean: 특히 어떤 남자아이들은 자기 자신만의 음악을 갖는 것을 좋아하고, 아주 오랜 시간 동안을 이것을 들으며 놀 수도 있다."
